purpose: Verify the chapter reader commands and correctness in the measured environment; do not use these operation-check timings as published benchmark results.

records.label: environment
records.command:
python - <<'END'
import platform,torch,triton
from importlib.metadata import version
print(platform.freedesktop_os_release()['PRETTY_NAME'])
print('torch',torch.__version__,'triton',triton.__version__,'rocm',version('rocm'),'HIP',torch.version.hip)
print(torch.cuda.get_device_name(),torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).gcnArchName)
assert '9070 XT' in torch.cuda.get_device_name()
assert torch.cuda.get_device_properties(0).gcnArchName=='gfx1201'
assert version('rocm')=='10.0.0'
END

records.label: ch11-compile
records.command:
test -d "${RUN:?请先准备本章环境与结果目录}/build" && \
if [[ ! -x "$RUN/build/matmul_hip" ]]; then
  hipcc --offload-arch=gfx1201 -O3 -std=c++17 \
    chapter11/matmul_hip.hip -o "$RUN/build/matmul_hip"
fi

records.label: ch11-restore-terminal
records.command: source ./activate-rocm.sh >/dev/null && read -r -p "粘贴上次输出的结果目录：" RUN && test -n "$RUN" && test -d "$RUN/build" && printf "继续使用结果目录：%s\n" "$RUN"

records.label: ch11-00-benchmark-command-operation
records.command:
test -d "${RUN:?请先准备本章环境与结果目录}/build" && \
test ! -e "$RUN/n1024x1024x1024-hip-tiled-t16-p1.csv" && \
"$RUN/build/matmul_hip" \
  --tile 16 --version tiled --m 1024 \
  --n 1024 --k 1024 --warmup 10 \
  --repeat 50 --seed 20260920 --config-id hip-tiled-t16 \
  --samples "$RUN/n1024x1024x1024-hip-tiled-t16-p1.csv" --process 1
